biography.value:
Description

A high-ranking demon who enjoys the sorrow and despair of humans. It is very unusual for demons of their class to form a contract with humans, but because gaining their help would lead to great wealth and power, many summoners continue to find a way to summon them to do their bidding. But these high-ranking demons aren't gullible, and their sly disposition makes it difficult to form a fair contract. Because of this, most people end up losing their souls to the full demon.

Defense

AC 32, touch 16, flat-footed 25 (+7 Dex, +16 natural, -1 size)

hp 370 [460] (20d10+260)

mp 138

Fort +25, Ref +13, Will +21

DR 15/cold iron or good;

Immune lightning, fire, poison;

Resist Earth 20, Ice 20;

SR 30

Weakness holy

Offense

Speed 40 ft., fly 90 ft. (good)

Melee +1 'vorpal' unholy longsword +31/+26/+21/+16 (2d6+19/19-20), +1 'vorpal' flaming whip +30/+25/+20 (1d4+7 plus 1d6 fire and entangle), slam +29 (1d10+5 plus silence) or 4 Slams +31 (1d10+11 plus silence)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (30 ft. with whip)

Special Attacks Concentrating Magical Power, Lvl. 3 Confuse, Lvl. 4 Flare, Lvl. 5 Death, Silence (DC 27 Will)

Spells Known (FC CL 20th, Concentration +28)

1st (DC 19) - Blizzard, Dark, Fire, Thunder

2nd (DC 20) - Blizzard II, Dark II, Fire II, Thunder II

3rd (DC 21) - Blizzara, Blizzard III, Dark III, Darkra, Fira, Fire III, Thundara, Thunder III

4th (DC 22) - Blizzard IV, Dark IV, Fire IV, Thunder IV

5th (DC 23) - Blizzaga, Darkga, Firaga, Gravity, Thundaga

6th (DC 24) - Abyss, Burst, Flare, Glacier

Statistics

Str 35, Dex 25, Con 36, Int 24, Wis 24, Cha 27

Base Atk +20; CMB +33; CMD 50

Feats Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Greater Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Initiative, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (longsword)

Skills Acrobatics +30, Bluff +31, Diplomacy +31, Fly +32, Intimidate +31, Knowledge (history) +31, Knowledge (planes) +31, Knowledge (religion) +31, Perception +38, Sense Motive +30, Stealth +30, Use Magic Device +31; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception

Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic; telepathy 100 ft.

SQ Vorpal Strike, Whip Mastery
